qa.q: Will it cool my room on May afternoons?
qa.answer: The AC is likely too small for your 180 sq ft room, especially on hot May afternoons. Your room needs about 1.75 ton, but this unit is only 1 ton, so it may struggle to cool effectively [CHK-COOL]. A review also notes it was “too small” for a similar-size top-floor room and never got properly cool [R-AC02-04].

qa.q: Do I need a stabilizer?
qa.answer: You don’t need a stabilizer for this unit; it operates across 145 V - 290 V and can handle voltage fluctuations on its own[CHK-VOLT]

qa.q: Is it quiet enough for a bedroom?
qa.answer: Yes, the AeroChill 1 Ton AC is fairly quiet for a bedroom. It has a noise level of 38 dB [SPEC:noise_db], and a reviewer noted that “Indoor unit is quiet enough to sleep” [R-AC02-11].

qa.q: How many decibels is the indoor unit?
qa.answer: The listing and reviews do not provide the indoor unit's decibel level. You may ask the seller in the product Q&A for that detail.

qa.q: Is the condenser copper?
qa.answer: Yes, the AC uses a copper condenser[SPEC:condenser].

qa.q: What is the warranty on the compressor?
qa.answer: The compressor comes with a 10-year warranty[SPEC:warranty_compressor_years].

qa.q: Will it fit my window?
qa.answer: The window AC requires a 61 cm × 41 cm opening, but your window is only 55 cm × 45 cm, so it will not fit. [CHK-FIT]

qa.q: What is the annual energy use?
qa.answer: The AeroChill 1.5 Ton AC uses about 990 kWh of electricity per year [ SPEC:annual_kwh ].

qa.q: Is it too big for my room?
qa.answer: Yes, the AC is larger than needed for your 100 sq ft room. The cooling-capacity check warns that a 2-ton unit is much bigger than the roughly 0.77-ton requirement, so it will cool quickly but may make the room clammy and cost more to run. [CHK-COOL]

qa.q: Will it fast-charge my phone?
qa.answer: It will charge your Orbit S24 Ultra, but only up to about 25 W via PPS, not the phone’s maximum 45 W fast-charging speed [CHK-FAST]. The included USB-C to USB-C cable fits your phone’s port [CHK-CABLE]. Customer reviews note the same “fast charging” level of roughly 25 W on the Orbit S24 Ultra [R-CH02-02]. So it works, just not at the phone’s full fast-charge rate.

qa.q: Do I need another cable?
qa.answer: Yes, you’ll need a separate USB-C-to-Lightning cable because the charger only includes a USB-C port and no cable for your Lightning phone [CHK-CABLE]. A reviewer also noted they had to buy a separate cable for an Aster 11 [R-CH01-08].

qa.q: Can it charge my laptop too?
qa.answer: Yes, it can charge your laptop. The charger supplies up to 65 W over USB-C, which matches your laptop’s 65 W requirement[CHK-LAPTOP].

qa.q: How many full charges will the power bank give my phone?
qa.answer: The power bank can give about 3.3 full charges of your 4000 mAh Orbit S24 battery (≈65 % of the 20 000 mAh rating is usable)[CHK-CAP].

qa.q: Does it come with a braided cable?
qa.answer: The listing only states a USB-A to USB-C cable is included and does not specify whether it is braided; the reviews also do not mention cable type. You may ask the seller in the product Q&A for clarification.

qa.q: Will I get ZenDash speed with this?
qa.answer: You won’t get ZenDash speeds with this charger; the ZenDash (80 W) protocol only works with the phone maker’s own charger, and third-party chargers like this one can’t reach it[CHK-PROP][R-CH03-04]

qa.q: How heavy is it?
qa.answer: The charger weighs 70 g[SPEC:weight_g].

qa.q: Will my biggest shoes fit?
qa.answer: Your UK 10 shoes are about 30.6 cm long, while each shelf is only 30 cm deep, so the heels may stick out a little [CHK-SIZE].

qa.q: Do I need to drill the wall?
qa.answer: Yes, this shelf must be screwed into the wall, which requires drilling - and you indicated you cannot drill[CHK-DRILL]. A reviewer also notes they couldn’t use it because their landlord wouldn’t allow drilling[R-SR05-08].

qa.q: How long does assembly take?
qa.answer: The cabinet takes about 90 minutes to assemble [SPEC:assembly_minutes].

qa.q: What is it made of?
qa.answer: It’s made of powder-coated steel[SPEC:material].

qa.q: Is it waterproof?
qa.answer: The listing and reviews do not mention any waterproof features or material protection. You may want to ask the seller in the product Q&A for details.

qa.q: How much weight can it take?
qa.answer: It can hold up to 120 kg of weight[SPEC:max_load_kg].
